definitions.gloss: flower vase; vessel for flower arrangement
definitions.explanation: A container used for displaying flowers, particularly in the context of {華道|かどう} (Japanese flower arrangement / ikebana). Can range from simple vases to elaborate ceramic or bamboo vessels.

examples.english: To arrange flowers in a flower vase.
I bought a ceramic flower vase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{花器|かき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選|えら}び→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{要素|ようそ}→要素：03661_youso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひとつだ。
examples.english: In flower arrangement, the choice of vase is also an important element.

notes:
A compound of {花|か} (flower) and {器|き} (vessel; container). While ⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧ is the everyday word for a flower vase, {花器|かき} is a broader and slightly more formal term that encompasses all types of vessels used for flower arrangement, including those used in ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧ (ikebana).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花器|かき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}け→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧る: to arrange flowers in a vase
- {花器|かき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a flower vessel
- ⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花器|かき}: ceramic flower vase
- ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花器|かき}: bamboo flower vase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧: flower vase — the everyday word for a vase, more common in general speech
- {壺|つぼ}: jar; urn — can also be used for flowers, but broader in meaning
- ⟦{器|うつわ}→器：11838_utsuwa⟧: vessel; container — general term for any dish or container
